items.name: Kyrgyzstan Open 2017
items.information: Online Registration ends on 20th December, 2017 or earlier if the competitor limit of 200 is reached. On the spot Registration is not allowed and Payment will be done at venue.

items.name: Rubik's Cube Mumbai Open 2017

venue.name: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute
venue.address: Nathalal Parekh Road, Matunga East, Mumbai, Maharashtra

items.information: There is no registration fee for this competition but registration on WCA is mandatory in order to compete. All competitors must be aware of the WCA regulations. There won't be any "On the Spot" Registrations available at the Venue on the competition days. Check the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksCubeMumbaiOpen2017#2854-schedule) tab for the competition Schedule Check the [Groups and other information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksCubeMumbaiOpen2017#2855-groups-and-other-information) tab for all the other relevant information regarding the competition
